feeds.sql: SELECT l.LINE_CODE AS ID, l.LINE_NAME AS LABEL, NVL(p.ACTUAL_QTY, 0) AS VALUE, NVL(l.DAY_PLAN_QTY, 0) AS TARGET, 'EA' AS UNIT FROM IP_PRODUCT_LINE l LEFT JOIN (SELECT LINE_CODE, SUM(ACTUAL_QTY) AS ACTUAL_QTY FROM IP_PRODUCT_SMD_PLAN WHERE PLAN_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 14 GROUP BY LINE_CODE) p ON p.LINE_CODE = l.LINE_CODE WHERE l.MES_DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' AND l.LINE_PRODUCT_DIVISION = 'SMD' ORDER BY l.MES_DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
